faq: What do you do with an order that looks wrong?
We hold it, note the reason, such as an incomplete address or a stock problem, and tell you. We do not cancel or refund an order without your approval.
Which platforms and tools do you work with?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix and Squarespace stores, plus common shipping tools. We work as staff in your accounts and never need your passwords.
Do you pack and ship the products?
No. We handle the order side: checking, tagging and passing orders to whoever ships them. Packing and shipping stay with you or your warehouse.
What if my order volume is higher than the package?
Choose the package that fits your count. If your volume is larger, we can quote a custom amount, so you only pay for the orders we handle.

desc:
An ecommerce order processing service checks each new order and moves it forward, so nothing waits in the queue. Ecom Swift LLC reviews address, stock, payment and shipping choice, then marks orders ready, held or sent to your fulfilment partner.

## What is order processing?

Order processing is everything that happens between a customer paying and the order being ready to ship. It includes checking the details, confirming the goods exist, deciding the shipping method, noting special requests and passing the order to whoever packs it.

Some stores automate part of this. Most still need a person for the exceptions: an address that looks wrong, a gift note, a product that sold out a minute earlier.

## Why a waiting queue hurts a store

Orders that sit unchecked age quickly. A customer who ordered yesterday and sees no sign of progress begins to wonder. An address typo found after dispatch costs a parcel. A stock error found a week later means an apology and a refund.

Small orders hide the problem and busy days expose it. A promotion, a mention in the press or a holiday weekend can fill the queue faster than one person can read it. Processing keeps a steady pace through those peaks.

## How careful processing protects results

Good processing makes fulfilment faster and more accurate. The packing team receives orders that are already confirmed, with the right shipping service and any notes attached. Fewer parcels bounce, fewer customers write in, and fewer refunds follow.

It also gives you data. When issues are logged in a simple way, patterns show up: one product that often runs out, one region with address problems, one payment method that fails. You can then fix the cause once.

## What a well-run processing routine includes

- A check of the shipping address for gaps or obvious errors.
- Confirmation that stock exists for every line.
- A look at the payment status before an order is released.
- A check that the chosen shipping method fits the contents.
- Tags that show where each order stands.
- Flags for customer notes and special requests.
- Rules to sort rush, gift and bulk orders.
- Handing of ready orders to your fulfilment partner or packing team.
- A list of problem orders, each with a suggested next step.
- A simple log of what was handled.

## What we do

We work through your new orders in the order they arrive, using the access you give us in your store. For each order we check the details, add the right tag, write any note for the packing team and send the order on. If something looks wrong, we do not guess. We add it to the problem list with what we found and what we suggest.

At the end of each working period you receive a summary of orders handled and issues found. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in volume and in extras such as tags, partner hand-off, sorting rules and a written process for your own team.

This is a fixed amount of processing during an agreed window. It is not a monthly contract, and if your volume turns out higher than the package, we tell you early and quote the extra.

We do not pack or ship products ourselves. Our work is the review and the hand-off.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your cut-off times and how you tag orders today.
- Say which products are often out of stock.
- Name the orders that always need your approval.
- Review the problem list quickly, so held orders move.

**Avoid:**
- Changing shipping rules during the window without telling us.
- Releasing orders with unpaid or pending payment status.
- Letting notes live only in email threads.
- Treating a held order as lost, when it is waiting on one answer.

## Who this is for

This suits an owner who is away for a week and needs someone watching the queue. It suits a store expecting a surge from a sale or a campaign. It also suits a business that has outgrown manual checking and wants to write down its own process before hiring.

## What we need from you

Send a short outline of how orders reach your packers, with the tools involved. Add us as a collaborator or staff user with permission to view and edit orders. We do not need passwords or payment account logins. After you order, we reply with a checklist and begin once we agree what we may decide alone.
